in_marathi.name: Pooran
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gold, Aureate, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pooran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Poorna' meaning 'Gold' or 'Aureate'. It symbolizes purity, light and radiance. In Hindu mythology, 'Poorna' is the name of the Goddess of prosperity and wealth.
